P.name: New Destiny
P.description: {{sbc|Innate - Double Barrel:}} '''Graves'''' {{tip|basic attacks}} fire his shotgun to consume [[ammunition]] within {{as|2 shells|buzzword3}}. He will reload over {{tt|a few seconds|See notes}} immediately after expending all {{as|shells|buzzword3}}, or after withholding a leftover {{as|shell|buzzword3}} {{tt|for a while|See notes}}. The reload time is {{tt|reduced|See notes}} by '''Graves'''' level and {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, and is cancelled if '''Graves''' reloads a {{as|shell|buzzword3}} with ''{{ai|Quickdraw|Graves}}'' or expends a leftover {{as|shell|buzzword3}}. '''Graves''' is {{tip|lockout|unable}} to declare basic attacks during the reload time if he has expended all {{as|shells|buzzword3}}.
P.description2: {{sbc|Innate - 12-Gauge:}} '''Graves'''' basic attack sprays {{as|4 pellets|buzzword2}} in a cone, each colliding with the first enemy unit in their path, dealing {{as|{{pplevel|key=%|100*(0.6895 + 0.01765*x*(0.595 + 0.0225*(x-1)))}} AD}} {{as|physical damage}} plus{{ft|{{as|{{pplevel|key=%|100*(0.6895 + 0.01765*x*(0.595 + 0.0225*(x-1)))*0.33302}} AD}} {{as|'''additional''' physical damage|physical damage}}|about one-third of the damage}}for each subsequent {{as|pellet|buzzword2}} hitting the same target, up to {{as|{{pplevel|key=%|100*(0.6895 + 0.01765*x*(0.595 + 0.0225*(x-1)))*(1+3*0.33302)}} AD}} {{as|'''total''' physical damage}} against a single target. Pellets deal 25% reduced damage against {{tip|structures}}.
P.description3: {{tip|Critical strikes}} spray {{as|6 pellets|buzzword2}} over a 25% wider cone, with each {{as|pellet|buzzword2}} dealing{{ft|{{as|{{critical damage|50}}|critical damage}} increased damage,|increased damage equal to {{sti|{{as|50% '''bonus''' critical damage}}}},}}resulting in{{ft|{{sti|critical damage|{{as|{{ap|((1+({{ccd|Graves|crit_base}}-100)*0.5/100)*(1+5*0.33302)/(1+3*0.33302)*100)|round=3}}% (+ {{ii|Infinity Edge|icononly=true}} {{ap|{{cid|Infinity Edge|critdamage}}*0.5*(1+5*0.33302)/(1+3*0.33302)|round=3}}%)|critical damage}}}} '''total''' damage|{{as|{{pplevel|key=%|100*(0.6895 + 0.01765*x*(0.595 + 0.0225*(x-1)))*(1+5*0.33302)*(1+({{ccd|Graves|crit_base}}-100)*0.5/100)}}|AD}} {{as|(+ {{ii|Infinity Edge|icononly=true}} {{pplevel|key=%|100*(0.6895 + 0.01765*x*(0.595 + 0.0225*(x-1)))*(1+5*0.33302)*({{cid|Infinity Edge|critdamage}}*0.5/100)}}) AD}} {{as|'''total''' physical damage}}}}if all pellets hit a single target.
P.description4: {{as|Pellets|buzzword2}} {{tip|applies life steal|apply}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}. Only the first {{as|pellet|buzzword2}} to hit each enemy applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects.
P.description5: {{sbc|Innate - Buckshot:}} Non-champion units hit by more than one {{as|pellet|buzzword2}} are {{tip|airborne|knocked back}}, though not through terrain.

Q.name: End of the Line
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Graves''' fires a round in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies it passes through and leaves behind a powder trail.
Q.description2: After 2 seconds, or {{rutngt|0.2}} upon colliding with terrain, the round detonates to deal {{as|physical damage}} to enemies within a wide perpendicular area and in a reverse wave along the powder trail.
Q.leveling2: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|80 to 260}} {{as|(+ {{ap|45 to 105}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|50+80 to 150+260}} {{as|(+ {{ap|55+45 to 55+105}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
Q.description3: ''Enemies can only be hit once per pass.''

W.name: Smoke Screen
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Graves''' fires a smoke canister at the target location that upon impact deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within the area and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 50% for {{fd|0.5}} seconds.
W.description2: The canister creates a cloud of smoke for 4 seconds that applies {{tip|nearsight}} of outside the area to all enemies within every {{fd|0.25}} seconds, reducing their {{tip|sight}} radius to {{tt|250 units|Estimated}} relative to the center.

E.name: Quickdraw
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Graves''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target location, reloading one {{as|shell|buzzword3}} while generating a {{tip|stack}} of ''True Grit'' for 4 seconds, stacking up to 8 times. Dashing towards an enemy {{tip|champion}} generates 2 stacks of ''True Grit''.
E.description2: ''Quickdraw's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced by {{fd|0.5}} seconds for every {{as|pellet|buzzword2}} impacting an enemy.
E.description3: {{sbc|True Grit:}} For each stack, '''Graves''' gains {{sti|armor|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}}, and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}} equal to 50% of that amount. Subsequent casts of ''Quickdraw'' and damage versus non-{{tip|minions}} will refresh the duration of ''True Grit''.
E.leveling3:
{{st|Bonus Armor|{{ap|7 to 19}}|Maximum Bonus Armor|{{ap|7*8 to 19*8}}}}
{{st|Bonus Magic Resistance|{{ap|7*0.5 to 19*0.5}}|Maximum Bonus MR|{{ap|7*0.5*8 to 19*0.5*8}}}}

R.name: Collateral Damage
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Graves''' fires an explosive shell in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit and causes him to {{tip|dash|recoil}} 400 units in the opposite direction.
R.description2: Upon hitting an enemy {{tip|champion}} or reaching the end of its range, the shell explodes in a cone to deal reduced damage to additional enemies.
